svg.title: Smaller enemy base layouts
svg.desc: Four authored floor plans drawn to the same scale. Rectangles show reserved module pads, green circles show capture zones, and dots show guard posts.
svg.text: Reserved module pads at the same scale. +Z is the rear; the main entrance is below each plan.
Auto tries Full → Compact → Courtyard → Roadside → Command post → Rally post at each candidate. Assembly radius remains 150 m.
